mapIdentity.scope: The 32-point ovoid map outline spans approximately 122 m by 176 m. The institutional architecture guide places the museum in the Casa de la Cultura complex and describes the roofed Ágora.

note: A pale low roof sits behind three horizontal levels of smoked mirrored glazing. The public entrance uses a charcoal sign and pale concrete edge. The surrounding terrain falls toward the park on the south side.
